agent_delivery_wake_pause.name: agent_delivery_wake_pause
agent_delivery_wake_pause.value:
(
                "agent_delivery"."paused_at" is null and "agent_delivery"."pause_step" is null
            ) or (
                "agent_delivery"."paused_at" is not null
                and "agent_delivery"."pause_step" between 0 and 2
                and "agent_delivery"."consecutive_failures" > 0
                and "agent_delivery"."last_failure_at" is not null
                and "agent_delivery"."last_failure_kind" is not null
            )

agent_delivery_active_run.name: agent_delivery_active_run
agent_delivery_active_run.value:
(
                "agent_delivery"."active_run_id" is null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_chat_id" is null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_computer_id" is null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_runtime_id" is null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_model_id" is null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_reasoning_effort" is null
                and "agent_delivery"."accepted_at" is null
                and "agent_delivery"."dispatched_at" is null
            ) or (
                "agent_delivery"."active_run_id" is not null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_computer_id" is not null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_runtime_id" is not null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_model_id" is not null
                and "agent_delivery"."active_run_reasoning_effort" is not null
            )

manual_lookup_audit_target_shape.name: manual_lookup_audit_target_shape
manual_lookup_audit_target_shape.value: ("manual_lookup_audit"."operation" = 'get' AND "manual_lookup_audit"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL AND "manual_lookup_audit"."query" IS NULL) OR ("manual_lookup_audit"."operation" = 'search' AND "manual_lookup_audit"."topic_id" IS NULL AND "manual_lookup_audit"."query" IS NOT NULL)

agents_creation_request.name: agents_creation_request
agents_creation_request.value:
("agents"."creation_nonce" is null and "agents"."creation_request_hash" is null)
                or ("agents"."created_by_agent_id" is not null and "agents"."creation_nonce" is not null
                    and "agents"."creation_request_hash" is not null)

agents_handle_grammar.name: agents_handle_grammar
agents_handle_grammar.value: "agents"."handle" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$' and (("agents"."factory_kind" = 'cove' and "agents"."handle" = 'cove') or lower("agents"."handle") not in ('agent', 'agents', 'all', 'busy', 'cove', 'everyone', 'haus', 'here', 'human', 'humans', 'idle', 'system'))

agents_description_length.name: agents_description_length
agents_description_length.value: "agents"."description" is null or char_length("agents"."description") between 1 and 500

agents_conversation_style_length.name: agents_conversation_style_length
agents_conversation_style_length.value: "agents"."personality" is null or char_length("agents"."personality") between 1 and 2000

agents_signature_emoji_length.name: agents_signature_emoji_length
agents_signature_emoji_length.value: "agents"."signature_emoji" is null or char_length("agents"."signature_emoji") between 1 and 64

agents_brief_length.name: agents_brief_length
agents_brief_length.value: "agents"."brief" is null or char_length("agents"."brief") between 1 and 4000

agents_configuration.name: agents_configuration
agents_configuration.value:
(
                ("agents"."computer_id" is null and "agents"."desired_runtime_id" is null and "agents"."desired_model_id" is null)
                or ("agents"."computer_id" is not null and "agents"."desired_runtime_id" is not null and "agents"."desired_model_id" is not null)
            )

artifacts_public_link_shape.name: artifacts_public_link_shape
artifacts_public_link_shape.value: ("artifacts"."public_token" is null and "artifacts"."public_link_created_at" is null and num_nonnulls("artifacts"."public_link_creator_agent_id", "artifacts"."public_link_creator_user_id") = 0) or ("artifacts"."public_token" is not null and "artifacts"."public_link_created_at" is not null and num_nonnulls("artifacts"."public_link_creator_agent_id", "artifacts"."public_link_creator_user_id") = 1)

attachments_message_ready.name: attachments_message_ready
attachments_message_ready.value:
"attachments"."message_id" is null or (
                "attachments"."chat_id" is not null and "attachments"."state" = 'ready'
                and "attachments"."message_position" is not null
                and "attachments"."message_position" >= 0
            )

chat_messages_author_shape.name: chat_messages_author_shape
chat_messages_author_shape.value:
(
                ("chat_messages"."author_user_id" is not null and "chat_messages"."author_agent_id" is null)
                or
                ("chat_messages"."author_agent_id" is not null and "chat_messages"."author_user_id" is null)
            )

chat_messages_session_generation.name: chat_messages_session_generation

chat_messages_reply_shape.name: chat_messages_reply_shape
chat_messages_reply_shape.value:
(
                "chat_messages"."reply_to_message_id" is null
                and ("chat_messages"."reply_root_message_id" is null or "chat_messages"."reply_root_message_id" = "chat_messages"."id")
            )
            or ("chat_messages"."reply_to_message_id" is not null and "chat_messages"."reply_root_message_id" is not null)

chats_description_length.name: chats_description_length
chats_description_length.value: "chats"."description" is null or ("chats"."kind" = 'channel' and char_length("chats"."description") between 1 and 500)

chats_shape.name: chats_shape
chats_shape.value:
(
                (
                    "chats"."kind" = 'channel'
                    and "chats"."name" is not null
                    and "chats"."dm_agent_id" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_one_stint" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_one_user_id" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_two_stint" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_two_user_id" is null
                    and "chats"."parent_chat_id" is null
                    and "chats"."parent_chat_kind" is null
                    and "chats"."anchor_message_id" is null
                    and (not "chats"."is_all" or "chats"."name" = 'all')
                )
                or (
                    "chats"."kind" = 'dm'
                    and "chats"."name" is null
                    and "chats"."color" is null
                    and "chats"."icon" is null
                    and "chats"."is_all" = false
                    and "chats"."dm_member_one_stint" is not null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_one_user_id" is not null
                    and "chats"."parent_chat_id" is null
                    and "chats"."parent_chat_kind" is null
                    and "chats"."anchor_message_id" is null
                    and (
                        (
                            "chats"."dm_agent_id" is null
                            and "chats"."dm_member_two_stint" is not null
                            and "chats"."dm_member_two_user_id" is not null
                            and "chats"."dm_member_one_user_id" collate "C" < "chats"."dm_member_two_user_id" collate "C"
                        )
                        or (
                            "chats"."dm_agent_id" is not null
                            and "chats"."dm_member_two_stint" is null
                            and "chats"."dm_member_two_user_id" is null
                        )
                    )
                )
                or (
                    "chats"."kind" = 'thread'
                    and "chats"."name" is null
                    and "chats"."color" is null
                    and "chats"."icon" is null
                    and "chats"."is_all" = false
                    and "chats"."dm_agent_id" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_one_stint" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_one_user_id" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_two_stint" is null
                    and "chats"."dm_member_two_user_id" is null
                    and "chats"."parent_chat_id" is not null
                    and "chats"."parent_chat_kind" in ('channel', 'dm')
                    and "chats"."anchor_message_id" is not null
                )
            )

cloud_agent_work_activity_shape.name: cloud_agent_work_activity_shape
cloud_agent_work_activity_shape.value:
("cloud_agent_work"."activity_summary" is null) = ("cloud_agent_work"."activity_at" is null)
                and ("cloud_agent_work"."activity_summary" is null
                    or char_length("cloud_agent_work"."activity_summary") between 1 and 120)

computer_system_events_shape.name: computer_system_events_shape
computer_system_events_shape.value:
("computer_system_events"."event_type" = 'management-command') = ("computer_system_events"."command" is not null)
                and ("computer_system_events"."event_type" = 'disconnected') = ("computer_system_events"."reason" is not null)

github_installations_tombstone.name: github_installations_tombstone
github_installations_tombstone.value:
("github_installations"."status" = 'removed') = ("github_installations"."removed_at" is not null)
                and ("github_installations"."status" = 'removed') = ("github_installations"."connection_id" is null)

github_trigger_configs_repositories.name: github_trigger_configs_repositories
github_trigger_configs_repositories.value:
(
                "github_trigger_configs"."repository_scope" = 'installation'
                and cardinality("github_trigger_configs"."repository_ids") = 0
                and cardinality("github_trigger_configs"."repository_names") = 0
            ) or (
                "github_trigger_configs"."repository_scope" = 'repositories'
                and cardinality("github_trigger_configs"."repository_ids") between 1 and 50
                and cardinality("github_trigger_configs"."repository_names") = cardinality("github_trigger_configs"."repository_ids")
            )

linear_identities_installed.name: linear_identities_installed
linear_identities_installed.value:
"linear_identities"."status" in ('draft', 'removed') or (
                "linear_identities"."oauth_client_id" is not null
                and "linear_identities"."app_user_id" is not null
                and "linear_identities"."handle" is not null
            )

linear_oauth_attempts_purpose.name: linear_oauth_attempts_purpose

linear_workspaces_tombstone.name: linear_workspaces_tombstone
linear_workspaces_tombstone.value:
("linear_workspaces"."status" = 'removed') = ("linear_workspaces"."removed_at" is not null)
                and ("linear_workspaces"."status" = 'removed') = ("linear_workspaces"."connection_id" is null)

linear_writes_succeeded.name: linear_writes_succeeded

linear_webhook_deliveries_ignored.name: linear_webhook_deliveries_ignored
linear_webhook_deliveries_ignored.value:
("linear_webhook_deliveries"."state" = 'ignored') = ("linear_webhook_deliveries"."ignored_reason" is not null)
                and ("linear_webhook_deliveries"."ignored_reason" is null or "linear_webhook_deliveries"."ignored_reason" in (
                    'unknown_workspace', 'workspace_inactive', 'unsupported_event',
                    'team_outside_access'
                ))

linear_webhook_deliveries_routing.name: linear_webhook_deliveries_routing
linear_webhook_deliveries_routing.value:
("linear_webhook_deliveries"."server_id" is null) = ("linear_webhook_deliveries"."workspace_id" is null)
                and ("linear_webhook_deliveries"."server_id" is not null or "linear_webhook_deliveries"."state" = 'ignored')

linear_webhook_deliveries_body.name: linear_webhook_deliveries_body
linear_webhook_deliveries_body.value:
("linear_webhook_deliveries"."body" is null or octet_length("linear_webhook_deliveries"."body"::text) <= 2097152)
                and ("linear_webhook_deliveries"."state" not in ('done', 'ignored') or "linear_webhook_deliveries"."body" is null)

message_causes_shape.name: message_causes_shape
message_causes_shape.value:
(
                "message_causes"."kind" = 'trigger_fire'
                and "message_causes"."trigger_id" is not null
                and "message_causes"."trigger_fire_id" is not null
                and "message_causes"."reminder_id" is null
                and "message_causes"."reminder_fire_id" is null
            ) or (
                "message_causes"."kind" = 'reminder_fire'
                and "message_causes"."reminder_id" is not null
                and "message_causes"."reminder_fire_id" is not null
                and "message_causes"."trigger_id" is null
                and "message_causes"."trigger_fire_id" is null
            )

message_tasks_claim_shape.name: message_tasks_claim_shape
message_tasks_claim_shape.value: "message_tasks"."claimed_at" is null or "message_tasks"."assignee_agent_id" is not null

reminder_agent_attention_shape.name: reminder_agent_attention_shape
reminder_agent_attention_shape.value:
(
                ("reminder_agent_attention"."attention_kind" = 'reminder' AND "reminder_agent_attention"."script" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("reminder_agent_attention"."attention_kind" = 'reminder_script'
                    AND octet_length("reminder_agent_attention"."script") between 1 and 16384)
            )

reminders_description_length.name: reminders_description_length
reminders_description_length.value: "reminders"."description" is null or char_length("reminders"."description") between 1 and 300

reminders_script_size.name: reminders_script_size

server_invitations_terminal.name: server_invitations_terminal
server_invitations_terminal.value:
("server_invitations"."accepted_at" is null) = ("server_invitations"."accepted_user_id" is null)
                and not ("server_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "server_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)

server_memberships_server_handle_key.name: server_memberships_server_handle_key
server_memberships_server_handle_key.where: "server_memberships"."revoked_at" is null and "server_memberships"."handle" is not null

server_memberships_handle_grammar.name: server_memberships_handle_grammar
server_memberships_handle_grammar.value: "server_memberships"."handle" is null or ("server_memberships"."handle" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$' and lower("server_memberships"."handle") not in ('agent', 'agents', 'all', 'busy', 'cove', 'everyone', 'haus', 'here', 'human', 'humans', 'idle', 'system'))

server_onboarding_cove_shape.name: server_onboarding_cove_shape
server_onboarding_cove_shape.value: ("server_onboarding"."agent_id" is null and "server_onboarding"."application_id" is null and "server_onboarding"."runtime_id" is null and "server_onboarding"."model_id" is null) or ("server_onboarding"."agent_id" is not null and "server_onboarding"."application_id" is not null and "server_onboarding"."runtime_id" is not null and "server_onboarding"."model_id" is not null)

trigger_fires_dedupe_key_length.name: trigger_fires_dedupe_key_length
trigger_fires_dedupe_key_length.value: "trigger_fires"."dedupe_key" is null or char_length("trigger_fires"."dedupe_key") between 1 and 200

triggers_instruction_size.name: triggers_instruction_size
